name: The Sisterhood Pasture
storyline:
Welcome to Moonlit Valley!

Your grandmother has left you a delightful surprise—a vacation lodge in the heart of a mysterious valley, Jacaranda Mansion!

Nestled in a secluded southwest valley, home mostly to ladies, it’s a hidden paradise with a rich cultural heritage. But beyond the familiar scents of home, there are secrets here—secrets tied to the lost myths you once heard from your grandmother as a child...

The immediate goal is clear: use the valley’s magical farming techniques and mysterious technologies to revive Jacaranda Mansion’s former glory! But with so much to explore, you’re free to set your own goals and chart your journey as you and the sisterhood discover the countless wonders of Moonlit Valley together.

As for your grandmother’s whereabouts? Don’t worry; she’s simply taken off on an impromptu road trip, riding her motorcycle into the horizon!
summary: Inspired by the folklore of Southwestern China, The Sisterhood Pasture is a cozy pixel-art farming game that blends life simulation with management. Tend your farm, embrace rural traditions, and build bonds with a vibrant community in a tranquil pastoral world.
